title: See dinosaur bones still in their rock
description: At Dinosaur National Monument’s Quarry Exhibit Hall, a wall of roughly 1,500 bones remains exposed in the ancient rock where they were found. Walk along the viewing levels, pick out ribs and vertebrae, and take in how densely the fossils overlap. A few places even let you touch real fossil bone, bringing a distant era briefly into reach.
teaser: Stand before a wall of dinosaur fossils in place.
goodToKnow: Indoor accessible exhibits; verify winter approach, visitor-center access and opening.
whyItMightDelightYou: The bones feel more astonishing when you see their original jumble rather than a tidy skeleton.
